items.name: hooks
items.direction: Narrate for a premium documentary YouTube channel about money and history. The narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller with a hint of mystery, energetic and punchy, never slow, never announcer-like. These are separate short lines for YouTube Shorts: read each one as its own complete take, with the same voice, energy and loudness every time, and leave a clear one-second pause between lines. Natural emphasis on dates and numbers; questions end with a curious lift.
lines: Narrator
You'd panic at 15% interest. Britain hit it in one afternoon in 1992. Did it work?
Narrator
You can get rich when a country's money falls. Here's the $10 billion version. How?
Narrator
Your central bank can print money forever, right? In 1992, Britain still ran out. Why?
Narrator
Would you bet twice your money on one trade? In 1992, one fund bet $10 billion. Why so sure?
Narrator
You could pay about £57 for a bet you never made. In 1992, every Briton did. How?
Narrator
Your money can borrow another country's reputation. In 1990, Britain tried it with Germany. What's the catch?
Narrator
You'd hide after spending $22 billion for nothing. In 1992, one minister joked instead. What happened to him?
Narrator
Your guaranteed return hides one question. In 1992, it cost Britain £3.3 billion. Who's defending it?
